segments.text:
V. 49.
Nathanael anſwered—Happy are they that are ready to believe, ſwift to receive the Truth and Grace of GOD. Thou art the Son of God—So he acknowledges now, more than he had heard from Philip: The Son of God, the king of Iſrael—A Conſeſſion both of the Perſon and Office of Chriſt.
